briefing: Field Report from Agent Polaris: This hour, we saw multiple developments in ongoing investigations and new allegations of fraud. The Feeding Our Future scheme in Minnesota continues to unfold, with 79 people now charged. The investigation into the parent company of Redbank Village is ongoing, and there are growing calls for a federal investigation. We also saw a report on a potential $16 billion in health savings discovered by the HHS Inspector General. These developments highlight the ongoing efforts to combat fraud and corruption across various sectors. We will continue to track these investigations and look for patterns and connections between entities and programs.
